mentions.name: AppQuery
mentions.description: A Ruby gem that makes raw SQL in Rails more intuitive. Queries live in files like app/queries/foo.sql.erb, with customizable casting, ERB-based parameterization, and helpers such as order_by and paginate. The gem parses and rewrites CTEs so basic operations (first, take, count) run performantly instead of using Rails' resultset.count, and it enables writing tests per CTE.
mentions.problem: Raw SQL in Rails is unintuitive, and operations like Rails' resultset.count on custom queries can be slow and hard to test per-CTE.
mentions.audience: Ruby on Rails developers working with raw SQL
